schema.origin: where it comes from: a paper (with its docs/specs/sources entry), a failed experiment, a review item, a conjecture of the theory brief
schema.refutation_criterion: quantitative, written before any computation: what result refutes the hypothesis
schema.protocol: data, model, metric and its noise floor, number of seeds (at least 5 for a quoted comparison)
schema.script: path under experiments/, with a --quick mode
schema.cost_estimate: CPU hours (at most 2 per run), GPU euros if any (needs the user's approval)
schema.status: proposed | registered | running | supported | refuted | dropped
schema.comparison: race objective C6: 'constraint mechanisms' or 'model families' when the hypothesis compares them, empty otherwise
schema.seeds: number of model seeds of the quoted comparison (at least 5)

hypotheses.statement: In E1, the equivariant velocity field (C_equivariant) gives a lower energy distance to the reference law on the test Γ than the baseline (A_reference).
hypotheses.origin: E1 published run, 2 seeds: 0.00257 vs 0.0118 (digest, test Γ); review §2.3 (seed counts) and CLAUDE.md rule 4
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(A) − ED(C) is not larger than 2 SE, or if C is below A in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if ED(A) − ED(C) is smaller than the Monte Carlo floor of the energy distance (digest: mc_noise_floors.n_gen.energy).
hypotheses.protocol: E1, test Γ (10 values), energy distance on standardized (Q, D, V), n = 3000 per set, V statistic. Five model seeds 0-4 (experiments/run_stage.sh); for each seed, mean of the metric over the test values of the parameter, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation of the 5 differences / sqrt(5).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: E1 for 5 seeds: one process per seed, about 1 h each at 2 threads (estimate), no GPU
hypotheses.results: Five seeds, test Γ: ED(A) 0.0127, ED(C) 0.0023; paired difference A − C = 0.0104 ± 0.0012 (mean ± SE), 8.8 SE; C below A for 5 of 5 seeds; difference 8.4 times the floor (0.00123). No criterion met: not refuted. Digest: E1, 'Paired comparisons' table.

hypotheses.statement: In E1, fine-tuning with the stationarity loss (F_stationarity_C) lowers the residual of the held-out degree-3 Liouville identities on the test Γ compared with the same fine-tuning without the loss (F0_control_C), without degrading the energy distance by more than 20 %.
hypotheses.origin: E1 published run, 2 seeds: Liouville deg 3, 0.0113 vs 0.0224 (digest, test Γ); report claims on stationarity losses
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference Liou3(F0) − Liou3(F) is not larger than 2 SE, or if F is below F0 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if the mean energy distance of F exceeds 1.2 times that of F0.
hypotheses.protocol: E1, test Γ, liouville_residual with MONO_TEST (degree 3, not used in training) and energy distance as in H1. Five model seeds 0-4 (experiments/run_stage.sh); for each seed, mean of the metric over the test values of the parameter, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation of the 5 differences / sqrt(5).
hypotheses.results: Five seeds, test Γ: Liouville deg 3, F 0.0338, F0 0.0172; paired difference F0 − F = −0.017 ± 0.013; F below F0 for 2 of 5 seeds; ED(F)/ED(F0) = 1.41. All three criteria met: refuted (verdict pending). Digest: E1, 'Paired comparisons' and 'Per seed, test Γ' tables. Five seeds show no gain; they do not establish a degradation (−1.2 and 1.0 SE).

hypotheses.statement: In E2, the stationarity loss in law (V5_potentials_stat) lowers the energy distance of the generated law on the test η compared with the same fine-tuning without the loss (V5_control).
hypotheses.origin: E2 published run, 1 seed: 0.699 vs 2.52 (digest, test η); review §2.3 (one seed) and §2.7 (gain concentrated at large η)
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(V5_control) − ED(V5_potentials_stat) is not larger than 2 SE, or if V5 is below its control in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if the gain comes from fewer than 3 of the 5 test η (per-η table of the digest, seed mean).
hypotheses.protocol: E2, test η (5 values), energy distance of the standardized physical features, n = 1000. Training data identical for all seeds; seeds change the networks, the generation and the tilting. Five model seeds 0-4 (experiments/run_stage.sh); for each seed, mean of the metric over the test values of the parameter, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation of the 5 differences / sqrt(5).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 70 min per seed at 2 threads (published run: 4023 s), 5 processes, no GPU
hypotheses.results: Five seeds, test η: ED(V5_control) 2.43, ED(V5) 0.925; paired difference 1.50 ± 0.27, 5.6 SE; V5 below control for 5 of 5 seeds; seed-mean gain at 3 of 5 test η (0.00951, 0.0135, 0.0190), loss at 0.00476 and 0.00673. No criterion met (third one at its limit): not refuted. Digest: E2, 'Paired comparisons' and 'Per test η, over the seeds' tables.

hypotheses.statement: In E4 (3D), generating vector potentials (W4_potentials, constraint by model design) gives a lower energy-distance ratio on the held-out η than generating free components (W0_free).
hypotheses.origin: E2 digest, across seeds: V4_potentials 2.44 against V0_free 4.37 (2D); offer: constraints 'through model design'; Proposition 1.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(W0_free) − ED(W4_potentials) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W4 is below W0 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Metric: C1 ratio of race/teams/claude/objectives.toml (energy distance on standardized physical features divided by the noise floor between two reference subsamples drawn from disjoint sets of trajectories).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the divergence penalty on the end-of-path prediction (W1_penalty, weight 10; constraint by a training loss) does not enforce the constraint: it lowers the relative divergence of B of the free model W0_free by less than a factor 10, and it does not lower the energy-distance ratio.
hypotheses.origin: E2 digest: V1_penalty rel. div. 0.342 (u) and 0.162 (B) against 0.407 for V0, energy distance 5.62 against 4.37; Proposition 3 (the penalty is unbiased at the optimum, which says nothing of a finite network).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed mean of the relative divergence of B of W1 is below one tenth of that of W0, or if ED(W0_free) − ED(W1_penalty) is larger than 2 SE with W1 below W0 in at least 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Relative divergence: mean over samples of milady.eval.metrics.divergence_relative of B.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU

hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(W2) − ED(W3) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W3 is below W2 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, fine-tuning the equivariant potentials model with the law-level stationarity loss (W5_stationarity: energy identity and magnetic-helicity identity E[⟨j·B⟩] = 0, imposed at every η of the range) lowers the absolute residual of the mean energy balance on the held-out η compared with the same fine-tuning without the loss (W5_control), without raising the energy-distance ratio by more than 20 %.
hypotheses.origin: E2 hypothesis H3 (not refuted: energy distance 0.925 against 2.43, energy residual 0.069 against 0.447) and E1 hypothesis H2 (refuted: no gain on the held-out identities); claim 1 of docs/specs/theory-brief.md §4; offer: 'energy balance' through 'training losses'.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference |res|(W5_control) − |res|(W5_stationarity) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W5 is below its control in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if the seed-mean energy-distance ratio of W5 exceeds 1.2 times that of the control.

Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Metric: C1 ratio of race/teams/claude/objectives.toml (energy distance on standardized physical features divided by the noise floor between two reference subsamples drawn from disjoint sets of trajectories). Residual: C3 metric (|E[injection − Dν − Dη]| / E[Dν + Dη]).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU

hypotheses.statement: In E4, imposing the stationarity identities at training time (W5_stationarity) gives a lower energy-distance ratio on the held-out η than imposing the same identities at sampling time by exponential tilting of the samples of the control model (W7_tilting: multipliers fitted on one half of the samples, the other half evaluated with its weights).
hypotheses.origin: E2 digest: 'in law: tilting' 4.04 against V5_potentials_stat 0.925, ESS/N 0.002 at the three largest test η; Proposition 7 (reweighting does not create mass); offer: 'training losses' against 'sampling procedures'.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(W7_tilting) − ED(W5_stationarity) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W5 is below W7 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Metric: C1 ratio of race/teams/claude/objectives.toml (energy distance on standardized physical features divided by the noise floor between two reference subsamples drawn from disjoint sets of trajectories). W7 is evaluated with milady.eval.metrics.weighted_energy_distance on 256 weighted samples; W5 on the same number of samples.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the B → −B equivariant velocity field (W4s_potentials_sym, constraint by model design) lowers the polarity asymmetry |P(⟨u·B⟩ > 0) − ½| of the generated law on the held-out η compared with the same model without symmetrization (W4_potentials), without raising the energy-distance ratio by more than 20 %.
hypotheses.origin: E1 hypothesis H1 and digest (asymmetry 0.0407 for A_reference against 0.00224 for C_equivariant); Proposition 4; the asymmetry of a finite set of trajectories (E1 digest, training data).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference asym(W4) − asym(W4s) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W4s is below W4 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if the seed-mean energy-distance ratio of W4s exceeds 1.2 times that of W4.

Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Metric: C1 ratio of race/teams/claude/objectives.toml (energy distance on standardized physical features divided by the noise floor between two reference subsamples drawn from disjoint sets of trajectories). Asymmetry: T2 metric, n = 512 (binomial floor 0.018).
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU

hypotheses.statement: In E4, conditional flow matching (W4_potentials: linear path, Heun, 100 network evaluations) gives a lower energy-distance ratio on the held-out η than a variance-preserving diffusion with ancestral sampling (W6_diffusion: v-prediction, 100 network evaluations), with the same latent space, network, training budget and seeds.
hypotheses.origin: Offer: 'diffusion or flow matching'; no measurement in this repository before the race.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the mean paired difference ED(W6_diffusion) − ED(W4_potentials) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W4 is below W6 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.

Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). hypotheses.statement: In the E4 reference data, the magnetic helicity spectrum is bipolar at every η: H(k = 1) < 0 and Σ_{k ≥ 2} H(k) > 0, with a large-scale energy fraction E_B(k = 1)/E_B between 0.2 and 0.8, so that the stationarity identity E[⟨j·B⟩] = Σ k² H(k) = 0 is a cancellation between the two signs.
hypotheses.origin: physicien, 2026-11-12 (conjecture C1: α-effect of a forcing with positive kinetic helicity, field at k = 1, forcing at k = 2); identity from d⟨A·B⟩/dt = −2η⟨j·B⟩.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if, at any of the 11 η, H(1) is not negative or Σ_{k ≥ 2} H(k) is not positive by 2 SE (SE over the trajectory means), or if E_B(1)/E_B falls outside [0.2, 0.8]. Stationarity gate, reported and not a refutation: z = trajectory mean of ⟨j·B⟩ over its SE; |z| > 2 at a value of η means that the identity is not yet stationary there.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 reference data only (24 trajectories per η): shell spectrum of the magnetic helicity, time mean per trajectory, then mean and SE over the trajectories. No model.
hypotheses.verdict: REFUTED (encadrant, 2026-11-12): recomputed from the raw snapshots at the 11 η, independently of the experiment code, every value equal to e4_reference.json. H(1) < 0 at 11 of 11 η (z from −19 to −58) and E_B(1)/E_B in [0.370, 0.438] hold; Σ_{k ≥ 2} H(k) > 0 by 2 SE fails at η = 0.0365 and 0.03309 (z = −1.4 and −1.2, sign undetermined) and at η = 0.03 (z = −5.5, negative). The criterion is unchanged since commit 68e2fd4.
hypotheses.results: Digest, E4, 'Reference: magnetic helicity spectrum and stationarity identities (H11)'. The sign change of H(k) is not between k = 1 and k = 2: the shell k = 2 (the forcing shell) is negative at every η (12 to 39 SE) and Σ_{k ≥ 3} H is positive at every η (encadrant recomputation, not a registered hypothesis: a post hoc reading). The identity E[⟨j·B⟩] = 0 holds at every η (|z| ≤ 1.7), as a cancellation between the shells k ≤ 2 and k ≥ 3 with the positive part peaking at k = 4. No model seed: 24 trajectories per η.

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the magnetic-helicity identity E[⟨j·B⟩] = 0 constrains the generated magnetic law more than the energy identity: on the samples of W4s_potentials_sym at the held-out η its normalized residual is at least twice that of the energy identity, and tilting on it alone lowers the error on the mean magnetic helicity more than tilting on the energy identity alone.
hypotheses.origin: physicien, 2026-11-12 (conjecture C2: the energy balance is dominated by u, its sensitivity to an error on B is D_η/(2P) ≈ 0.08-0.15 against 0.5-1.5 for the helicity identity).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed mean of r_b/r_a is below 2, or if r_b > r_a in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds, or if the paired difference |err H_M|(tilt a) − |err H_M|(tilt b) is not larger than 2 SE; if ESS/N of the tilt on (b) is below 0.1 the tilting part is reported as a negative result.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). r_a = |E[P − Dν − Dη]| / E[P + Dν + Dη]; r_b = |Σ_k E[J(k)]| / Σ_k |E[J(k)]| with J(k) the shell spectrum of ⟨j·B⟩. Tilting fitted on one half of the samples, evaluated with weights on the other half.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the error of a generator on the number of magnetic null points follows its error on the magnetic Taylor wavenumber k_λ = (⟨|j|²⟩/⟨|B|²⟩)^½ as N ∝ k_λ³: over all (variant, held-out η, seed) points, the slope of ln(N_gen/N_ref) against ln(k_λ,gen/k_λ,ref) lies between 2 and 4.
hypotheses.origin: physicien, 2026-11-12 (conjecture C3: Kac-Rice count of the zeros of a solenoidal Gaussian field, N = 4.88 k_λ³ per (2π)³ box in the Gaussian limit, constant from its own Monte Carlo; fewer nulls when the k = 1 field is coherent).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the least-squares slope falls outside [2, 4] or if R² < 0.5. Protocol check first, not a refutation: the null count of the reference must change by less than 10 % between the 48³ and 64³ evaluation grids.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Null points: milady.eval.topology (trilinear method) on fields evaluated on a 48³ grid, 200 snapshots per value.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the relative divergence of the free model W0_free is a representation error of the network and not an integration error (Proposition 2, consequence (c)): on the held-out η it is of order one with 50 Heun steps (above 0.1) and changes by less than 20 % with 200 steps.
hypotheses.origin: docs/specs/theory-brief.md, Proposition 2 (d): 'Reading of E2 (hypothesis, not measured): the relative divergence 0.41 of the free model V0 is a representation error of the network in the sense of (c), not an integration error.'
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed-mean relative divergence of B of W0_free with 50 steps is below 0.1, or if its ratio between 200 and 50 steps falls outside [0.8, 1.2].
hypotheses.protocol: E4 (experiments/e4_data.py, e4_mhd3d.py): forced ABC MHD at kf = 2, 16³, every Galerkin mode generated; 6 training, 2 validation and 3 held-out test values of η; n = 512 generated snapshots per value, Heun 50 steps. Five model seeds 0-4; for each seed, mean of the metric over the 3 test η, then the paired difference between the two variants. SE = standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the 5 differences / sqrt(5). Same noise for the two step counts, n = 128.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: about 1 h of one CPU core per seed and per group of variants (two groups), no GPU

hypotheses.statement: In E4, the error of the generators at the held-out η comes from the embedding of the condition: the Fourier embedding of the pre-race code has frequencies up to 8 cycles over the normalized parameter range, above the Nyquist frequency of the 6 training values (spacing 0.18), so the velocity field is aliased between them. With a smooth embedding (frequencies between 0.5 and 1 cycle; W4c_potentials_smooth), the energy-distance ratio of the potentials model on the held-out η is at least halved.
hypotheses.origin: Failed experiment: first full E4 runs (seeds 0 and 1, logs of 2026-11-12): W0_free and W4_potentials at 200 to 250 times the floor on the held-out η with an error on E_B(k) above 2, worse than the --quick run of 150 iterations; a scratch diagnostic (800 iterations) gives a generated latent 16 % too wide at a held-out η whatever the integration step. The same embedding is used by E1 and E2 (experiments/common.py), where the held-out error is also far above the training error (digest: V4_potentials 2.44 on test η against 1.03 on training η).
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: Refuted if the seed-mean energy-distance ratio of W4c_potentials_smooth on the held-out η is more than half that of W4_potentials, or if the paired difference ED(W4) − ED(W4c) is not larger than 2 SE, or if W4c is below W4 in fewer than 4 of the 5 seeds.
hypotheses.protocol: E4 as for H4: same data, network size, budget, seeds 0-4, n = 512, Heun 50 steps; the only change is the maximum frequency of the condition embedding (ResMLP argument cond_scale: 8 in W4_potentials, 0.5 in W4c_potentials_smooth). Paired difference of the per-seed means over the 3 held-out η; SE = sd(ddof = 1)/sqrt(5). The training-η rows are reported next to the held-out ones.
hypotheses.cost_estimate: one training per seed (15 min of one CPU core, or seconds of GPU), no new data
